properties.name: Across a family of tests, the family-wise error rate (or false discovery rate) is a budget each test spends, through reflow2's existing budget rollup, with a served recipe saying how
properties.statement:
A study with k tests records α_family as a Constraint with a limit, and each test constrains it with its contribution (Bonferroni: α/k each; Holm and Benjamini–Hochberg are named in the recipe). budget_report then says whether the family stays within its error budget, and a test added later is visibly over budget. This is mostly a served recipe, in the argument and study skills, over the existing budget machinery and the owner-set failure budget (dec:idea-what-reflow2-can-learn-from-evaluator-guided-llm-circuit-design, (g)). Add code only where the rollup cannot express it.
Option (d) of flo2-calc's dec:idea-how-a-statistical-hypothesis-test-is-designed-computed-and-read.
